name: Eli Lilly
notes: revenue = 'Revenue' (pre-2005 'Net sales'). operatingIncome = 'Income before income taxes' (continuing operations) for all years, since Lilly reports no consistent operating income line 2000-2025. Figures as originally reported in the 10-K for that year (2010-2012 from FY2012 10-K, 2013-2015 from FY2015 10-K). 2018 and earlier include Elanco animal health; 2019+ exclude it (Elanco treated as discontinued ops from 2019; FY2019 10-K restates 2018 revenue to 21,493.3 and pre-tax to 3,680.1). 2008 pre-tax loss reflects $4.69B ImClone acquired IPR&D charge. 2010-2025 figures read from SEC XBRL companyconcept API filtered by 10-K accession; pre-tax sourceUrl is the IncomeLoss...BeforeIncomeTaxes concept endpoint named in source.
